claims.statement: Steam Engine preserves AW IMR 18650 2000mAh 5C as a 2000mAh preset with a 5C runtime rating.

AW IMR 18650 2000mAh samples are documented as red, button-top, and unprotected; observed dimensions vary between 18.4 mm × 65.2 mm in the comparison guide and 18.2 mm × 65.9 mm in a historical specification repost.

The AW IMR 18650 catalog entry is a branded rewrap or protected branded cell marketed in an IMR/INR/ICR-family lithium-ion context, but the exact cathode chemistry and underlying OEM were not established.
The exact catalog entry AW IMR 18650 has reliable market-introduction evidence dated 2012-06-07 or earlier.
